text: First time in Singapore? Leave some room in the plan. Give three days to three routes.
Changi is in the east. The waterfront sights are to the south. Drop your bags, then begin at Marina Bay.
On day one, follow the waterfront: the Merlion, Marina Bay Sands, and Gardens by the Bay.
See the skyline by day, and save the Supertrees for evening. Keep indoor sights for the hottest hours.
On day two, eat your way through the historic districts. Start with Chinatown shophouses, then a meal at Maxwell Food Centre.
Continue to Little India, then Kampong Glam. Sultan Mosque and Haji Lane fit into the same walk.
Take the metro between districts, and walk within them. Leave time for side streets, instead of another taxi ride.
Day three belongs to Sentosa. From HarbourFront, head through VivoCity for the Sentosa Express, or walk across the boardwalk.
Choose one focus: beach time or Universal Studios Singapore. Give the theme park room, instead of packing two days into one.
Contactless bank cards make transit simple. Tap in and out with the same card and payment method. Keep card and phone separate.
Carry an umbrella and water. Walk early or late. Save midday for hawker centres and indoor sights, with room for a change of weather.
Three days. Three routes. First the bay, then the neighbourhoods, and finally, time by the sea.
